name: How much does a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews varies depending on the complexity and size of your website, the number of pages to be audited, and the depth of analysis required. Factors such as industry competition and the current state of your site's content also play a role. We typically offer customized proposals after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and business goals. This ensures you receive a tailored solution that provides maximum value for your investment in AI visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on website size, complexity, and desired depth of analysis. Customized proposals are provided after an initial consultation.
